description: Harmonised National Roadworks and Road Closures is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Freight Data. This national harmonised dataset uses daily updates from State and Territory roadworks endpoints (APIs) to build a nationally consistent, harmonised historic database of roadworks and road closures over time across all of Australia. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher National Freight Data. Its tags are Infrastructure, Investment, National, Road. It offers 4 resource(s) in API, CSV, GEOJSON, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
